messages:
Claire: Hey folks — quick sync: need to finalize DP feedback gating rules for the private preview starting next month. Goal: predictable signal collection + clear launch triggers so eng/ops know when to scale or roll back.
Ravi: +1. Proposed gating taxonomy: critical / major / minor. Only critical blocks GA. Examples of critical: data exfiltration, model hallucinations that cause loss of funds, or regressions >5% on core evals for 2 consecutive runs.
Imani: Recruitment ops note — target 12 active partners (bench 18), with at least 8 generating production traffic within 4 weeks of kickoff. Incentives: $500 credits + concierge onboarding + priority support. Legal needs NDA link before kickoff.
Sam: For feedback loops: weekly 5-min survey + async Looms for big issues, plus a shared #dp-feedback channel. Propose a "feedback delta" metric: percent of partners reporting new unique issues week-over-week (target <20% after week 3).
Jordan: From SE: require a short reproducibility runbook per partner and canonical prompt set (10 prompts) to attach to each feedback ticket. That speeds triage. Also want a labeled severity field on reports.
Claire: Draft launch/readiness criteria proposal: retention >=70% WoW among partners, NPS >=7 on week-2 survey, no unresolved criticals older than 72h, and key perf SLOs within 1.2x baseline for 7 days. If any of these fail, hold GA.
Ravi: Add automated fallback: if latency >2x SLO AND >20% of requests impacted for 6h, trigger auto-route to previous model variant and page eng-oncall. Need to document the exact rollback knob.
Imani: Timeline + owner asks: Outreach this week, firm commitments by EOW, kickoff sessions next Tue & Thu. I'll run outreach cadence (owner: Imani). Legal: need NDA template by Fri.
Sam: Invite email draft (use as template):
```
Subject: Redwood DP invite — private preview access + $500 credits
Hi <Name>,
We'd love to invite you to a private preview of Redwood Private. You get early access, a dedicated onboarding engineer, and $500 platform credits. If interested, please: 1) review & sign NDA (link), 2) share 10 representative prompts, 3) confirm expected monthly tokens.
Kickoff call options: Tue 10am / Thu 2pm PT.
Thanks!
Sam (DP ops)
```
Jordan: :thumbsup: Also add a short checklist for partner integration: network allowlist, KMS pointer if using private keys, and sample cURL quickstart.
invite-bot: New candidate added: acme-ops accepted invite (tokenized invites sent)
Claire: Owner mapping for docs/tasks: Claire (PM) overall, Imani (recruitment/onboarding), Ravi (engine/runbook & rollback), Sam (feedback UX & surveys), Jordan (SE/integration). I'll update the DP playbook and publish the triage matrix.
Ravi: I'll drop a short `rollback.md` snippet into the repo with the thresholds and the `route_fallback=true` switch.
Imani: I'll set up the #dp-feedback channel and weekly survey in SurveyMonkey — will share the link here once ready.
Sam: We'll wire a small dashboard (per-partner delta, NPS, unresolved criticals). UX will be minimal but focused.
Claire: Next steps: owners update playbook by EOD Fri, outreach starts Mon, kickoff next Tue. If no objections by EOD today I'll lock these gates.
Jordan: No objections here. Good plan.
Claire: Thanks everyone — I'll paste the final checklist here later. :party_parrot:
